about_short_description.short_description: Axolo is a bidirectional Github-Slack integration to help tech teams reduce pull request time and improve code review feedback.

product.name: Axolo GitHub Slack Integration
product.description: A bidirectional integration between GitHub and Slack that creates ephemeral Slack channels for each pull request to centralize code review discussions and notifications.

product.name: Axolo GitLab Actions Slack Notification
product.description: A Slack notification system that delivers GitLab CI/CD pipeline and deployment updates directly to Slack channels associated with merge requests.

identifier.value: Axolo Two-Way Sync Between Slack & GitHub

product.name: Axolo Two-Way Sync Between Slack & GitHub
product.description: A synchronization tool that mirrors comments and updates between GitHub and Slack, enabling seamless two-way communication on code reviews.

identifier.value: Axolo Pull Request Channels and Automated Reminders

product.name: Axolo Pull Request Channels and Automated Reminders
product.description: A feature that creates dedicated Slack channels for each pull request and sends automated reminders to ensure timely code reviews and reduce merge delays.

identifier.value: Axolo Customizable Notification Settings and Code Review Time Slots

product.name: Axolo Customizable Notification Settings and Code Review Time Slots
product.description: A configurable notification system that allows teams to receive GitHub pull request updates and reminders only during specified time slots to minimize distractions.

product.name: Axolo Standup Bot for Slack
product.description: A Slack bot that sends daily pull request recaps and standup notifications to keep engineering teams aligned and informed about code review progress.
